## How to buy

1. Share product, quantity, specification and destination via /contact or WhatsApp.
2. Shrim Export reviews sourcing availability and suitable product options.
3. Quotation and commercial terms are confirmed in writing before shipment.

## Optional

- Custom packaging: bulk, retail, private label, custom
- Markets: international buyers; packing and documentation aligned to destination country
